meta.note: Compat full run on the rebase of #21340 onto main a9501d5d40 (gxt 0.0.82) with the hang1 fix (helper args / (hash) args re-render loops) and the hang2 fixes ((fn) arguments, trackedArray in-place changes, helper named args, per-call-site helper instances), written by runner.mjs; emberCommit is the last code commit. 8804/9948 green, no timeouts. Main rewrote the @glimmer-workspace integration harness (Test cleanup 3-10/10): the [integration] suites now render through Ember's renderComponent, which under GXT_MODE is GXT, instead of driving the Glimmer VM, so their reds are GXT conformance gaps (1143/2144 green). The three modules that hung the renderer before hang1 are included ([integration] jit :: Components :: Glimmer, its > [integration] Glimmer sub-module, and argument-less helper paren-less invoke). The other reds are tests main added or rewrote (Glimmer components instead of classic ones, .gjs conversions, route managers, standalone tracked(), {{#each-in}} key, {{on}} listener order). 88 tests are QUnit.skip, 53 of them rehydration tests unsupported under GXT (gxt-delegate.ts GXT_UNSUPPORTED). The known non-bug: ember-template-compiler custom plugins passed to compile (no tests registered).
